# LLM Legos

## 1 Running the Game:
### run the executable build.bat or build.sh script depending on
### cd into team_lapSup_hackathon26\build\Debug\my_raylib_game.exe and run this executable

### You are a little traveler that just arrived in town, and the townspeople are completely helpless
### Infinite problems have no end in sight. Your task is to put up a good fight
### It's a point-and-click adventure, and the Inhabitants of this small, forgotten town have problems that don't seem to end.
### Tasks and quests are automatically generated and randomized.
